text: Sign in to T3 for 0080's live check: run 'braid t3 login' (branch build) and 'braid t3 status', then tell the PM
context:
0080 (the board talks to T3 directly): steps D (sign-in) and E (Hold reaches every thread) are merged into the braid branch. Before the final PR into main they need one live check with your real T3 sign-in; a checker does everything else on scratch copies (scratch home, test board on port 7850, scratch threads).
1. Run: node C:\worktrees\agento\plan-board-t3\dist\cli.js t3 login  -> approve "braid board" at Full access in T3's page; the terminal says "Signed in to T3 ... until <date>".
2. Run: node C:\worktrees\agento\plan-board-t3\dist\cli.js t3 status  -> "signed in ... Full access ... (in 30 d)".
3. Tell the PM "signed in". Later, when asked: revoke "braid board" in T3 Settings -> Sharing & access, then run "... t3 logout".
The token goes only into Windows' secret store.
